hook.text: A truck arrives at a warehouse, and its goods are loaded onto another truck within hours. No shelving.

buildup.text: Cross-docking moves goods from inbound to outbound vehicles with minimal or zero storage time.

discovery.text: It cuts warehousing costs, speeds delivery, and reduces inventory handling at distribution centers.

twist.text: It only works when inbound and outbound schedules are tightly synchronized. One delay breaks the flow.

climax.text: Walmart pioneered cross-docking in the 1980s. It became a core advantage over slower competitors.

punchline.text: Skip the shelf. Move it straight through.

quiz.question: What is cross-docking?
options: Moving goods from inbound to outbound with minimal storage
